public_rationale: The ten tasks can be recovered, but the available evaluations do not establish their July 28 completion count. Research documents relevant progress in games and proof formalization without satisfying the full wager criteria. Those results neither prove three passes nor establish that eight tasks were beyond current systems. Marcus's own count cannot supply the missing independent assessment.
limitations: The source list is not a comprehensive audit of every available system.
Award-level quality and some feasibility rules require judgment.
Later capabilities cannot be substituted for capabilities on the post date.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: By Marcus's count, current AI can do at most two of the ten expert-level tasks in his bet with Miles Brundage.

statement.excerpt: The number of the above that actual current AI can do is still by my count no more than two.
statement.document_title: Sorry, Sam and Elon, we have not reached the Singularity

from_speaker: borrowed from the bet I made here 18 months ago with Miles Brundage
our_interpretation: Assess the objective capability count, rather than merely whether Marcus held this opinion.
Current means capability as of July 28, 2026. This is an instantaneous capability claim, so the target is the publication day rather than a financial reporting period.

Use the original task-specific standards: film understanding, novel understanding, sourced biographies and obituaries, learning unfamiliar games, legal briefs, reliable large-program construction, exceptional books, exceptional screenplays, major scientific discoveries, and mathematical proof formalization.
Preserve the bet's reliability, assistance, generality and resource restrictions. Do not substitute an ordinary benchmark pass for completion of a task.
The original tasks have different human comparison levels; do not impose a best-human threshold on every task.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive assessment of systems available by the post establishes that no more than two tasks meet their original criteria. Missing demonstrations alone do not establish inability.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Verifiable results establish that systems available by the post meet at least three of the ten original task criteria.

evidence.explanation: This jointly stated agreement defines the assessment standards. It provides no independent evidence of the number achieved in July 2026; the source-type vocabulary has no category for a personal public agreement.

The paper reports generalization to unfamiliar environments and autonomous skill learning. It does not establish mastery of almost any new game within the wager's time allowance, and its experiments predate the target day.
This is substantial progress relevant to proof formalization. A topology project does not establish success on the wager's specified sample across mathematical fields or resolve the ten-task total.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A dated, reproducible assessment of July 28 systems under the ten original criteria, establishing at least three passes or a reliable upper bound of two.
